harness_substitutions.imports: All production modules and tests imported from integrated live paths; no source substitution and no changed guard logic.
harness_substitutions.tempfile: tempfile.tempdir and TMPDIR select integration-001/tmp/<group>. Only TemporaryDirectory(dir=live lean/.cache or live lean/.cache/reuse-unit) is redirected there. Other explicit temporary directories retain their arguments.
harness_substitutions.mkdir: Only Path.mkdir calls for exactly live lean/.cache and live lean/.cache/reuse-unit are no-ops; this prevents test scaffolding writes. All other mkdir and production filesystem behavior is unchanged.
harness_substitutions.environment: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; AC_FORMAL_CONTROL_EVIDENCE removed to prevent optional external retention. Python launched with -I -S -B.
harness_substitutions.output: Each suite preserves combined stdout and stderr in its own .log.
harness_substitutions.proof: Existing reuse tests themselves stub proof/support/runtime and choose synthetic isolated origins. No live-origin setup, Lean/compiler/kernel or model actor invocation.

distinct_existing_suite_coverage: 57 existing Lean Python tests add importer/fixture reconstruction, source-only CLI namespace/currentness, malformed evidence/status handling and bounded Python child-process cleanup.
